verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state stealth Chromium is enabled by default, residential proxies across 195+ countries are default, and automatic CAPTCHA solving with human-in-the-loop fallback is available—directly matching the story's fingerprinting/proxy/anti-bot needs. Missing for 10: independent third-party verification that proxies actually evade bot-detection in practice, and no documented control over choosing specific geo-targets vs default global pool.
